collection.title: Road to Avengers: Doomsday
collection.description: Marvel watchlist based on the titles supplied by the user. Priority indicates how useful each title is for understanding announced Doomsday characters and established multiverse context.
collection.target_release_date_note: Release date shown on the Disney Movies page checked on 2026-11-20; regional release dates may differ.

priority_definitions.essential: Strongly recommended for the main character or story context.
priority_definitions.recommended: Useful background for characters, factions, or story concepts.
priority_definitions.optional: Can be skipped without losing the core Doomsday setup.

connection_status_definitions.confirmed: Direct character/franchise connection supported by the announced Doomsday cast or official premise.
connection_status_definitions.indirect: Provides wider MCU, character, or multiverse background but is not an established direct prerequisite.
connection_status_definitions.unconfirmed: A possible connection is not established by official information.
